search.label: Search help articles
search.title: Search results
search.prompt: Type what you are looking for above.

empty.heading: No results for “{{q}}”
empty.body: Check the spelling, or try fewer or different words.

home.title: How can we help?
home.intro: Search our guides or browse by topic.
home.empty: Nothing has been published here yet.

fallback.title: This article is not available in {{language}} yet.
fallback.body: We are showing you the {{original}} version until it is translated.

feedback.question: Was this article helpful?
feedback.thanksBody: We will use your answer to improve this article.
feedback.missing: What was missing from this article?
feedback.hint: Do not write your card details. We will not reply to this note; for help, use the chat.

help.heading: Still need help?
help.body: Our team is here when the articles do not answer your question.
help.articleBody: Start a chat and we will bring this article with you.
help.searchBody: Tell us what you were looking for.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: We can’t find that page
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the article may have moved. Try a search.
notFound.home: Go to the help center home

gone.title: Article archived
gone.heading: This article was archived
gone.body: “{{title}}” was retired on {{date}} and is no longer kept up to date.

wall.title: Sign in
wall.heading: Sign in to read the team knowledge base
wall.body: This help center is for {{brand}} staff only. Sign in with your staff account to continue.
wall.button: Sign in with your staff account
wall.note: You will come back to the page you asked for. Customer accounts cannot open this help center.

draft.title: Draft preview
draft.body: Only signed-in staff can see this page. It is not published and not in search or the sitemap.

scheduled.title: Scheduled
scheduled.body: Publishes on {{date}}. Until then only signed-in staff can see it.

changes.title: Unpublished changes
changes.body: You are previewing a new draft. Visitors see the version published on {{date}}.

archived.title: Archived
archived.body: Visitors get “This article was archived”. You see it because you are signed in as staff.

signIn.title: Sign in to see your tickets
signIn.lead: Enter the email address you write to us from. We will send you a link; there is no password.
signIn.invalid: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.
signIn.tooMany: Too many requests for a sign-in link. Try again in an hour.
signIn.captchaFailed: The check did not pass. Try again.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If {{email}} has tickets with us, we sent it a link. It works once, for 15 minutes.
sent.hint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check spam, or {{link}}.

confirm.title: Continue to your tickets
confirm.body: You are signing in to {{site}} as {{email}}.
confirm.note: Did not ask for this? Close this page. Nobody is signed in until Continue is pressed.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Sign-in links last 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: Each link works once. If that was you, you may already be signed in.

stale.title: This page is out of date
stale.body: Open the sign-in page again and try once more.
